Killing <stasis/>Frozen or <stasis/>Slowed enemies grants Class Ability Energy based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 9% 
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 13%
• Enemy Players: 15%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 20%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites: 30%
• T4 Elites, Minibosses: 40%
• Bosses: 50%
